def _create_rounded_combobox(self, parent, textvariable, values, width, state, outer_bg):

            panel_bg=self.INPUT_BG, border_color=self.BORDER_SOFT, title_fg=

            self.INPUT_BG, border_color=self.BORDER_SOFT, title_fg=self.TEXT,
            radius=12, padding=(8, 4))

    shell.body.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        values=values, width=width, style='RoundedField.TCombobox')
    combo.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky='ew')
    return shell, combo

def _set_dekband_mode_active(self, active, status_text):
    enabled = bool(self.settings.template_include_cross_sections)
    if active:
        if enabled:
            self.maaiveld_mode_active = False
            self.maaiveld_markers.clear()
            self.maaiveld_marker_payloads.clear()
            self._clear_reference_point_mode_state()
    if active:
        self.dekband_mode_active = bool(enabled)
    else:
        self.dekband_mode_active = bool(active)
    self.dekband_pending_layer = None
    self.dekband_pending_profile = None
    self.dekband_pending_chainage = None
    self.dekband_pointer_world = None
    if not self.dekband_mode_active:
        self.dekband_return_to_editor_layer = None
        self._refresh_map_edit_button_states()
        self.request_render(refetch_background=False)
        if not status_text:
            self.set_status('Dekbandmodus uitgeschakeld.')
            return None
        else:
            self.set_status(status_text)
            return None
    current_layer = self._current_tiff_layer_for_dekband()
    if current_layer is None:
        self.dekband_return_to_editor_layer = None
        self._refresh_map_edit_button_states()
        self.request_render(refetch_background=False)
        if not status_text:
            self.set_status('Kies eerst een proefsleuf om een dekband te plaatsen.'
                )
            return None
        else:
            self.set_status(status_text)
            return None
    current_profile = self._build_maaiveld_profile_for_layer(current_layer)
    self.dekband_pending_layer = current_layer
    self.dekband_pending_profile = current_profile
    self._refresh_map_edit_button_states()
    self.request_render(refetch_background=False)
    if not status_text:
        self.set_status(
            'Klik op de kaart voor het beginpunt van de dekband in ' + str(
            current_layer.name) + '.')
        return None
    else:
        self.set_status(status_text)
        return None

    self.request_render(refetch_background=False)

def _line_local_coordinates(point_x, point_y, start_world, end_world):
    dx = end_world[0] - start_world[0]
    dy = end_world[1] - start_world[1]
    length = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    if length <= 1e-09:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    unit_x = dx / length
    unit_y = dy / length
    normal_x = -unit_y
    normal_y = unit_x
    rel_x = point_x - start_world[0]
    rel_y = point_y - start_world[1]

    offset = rel_x * normal_x + rel_y * normal_y
    return along, offset, length

def _edit_selected_tiff_comment(self):
    layer = self._selected_tiff_layer()
    if layer is None:
        return None
    existing_text = self._tiff_comment_text(layer)
    comment_text = self._prompt_multiline_input(title='Proefsleuf Opmerking',
        prompt=
        'Voer de opmerkingen voor deze proefsleuf in. Elke regel wordt apart in de export opgenomen.'
        , initialvalue=existing_text, confirm_label='Opslaan')

        return None
    normalized_text = comment_text.strip()
    had_existing = bool(existing_text)
    self._set_tiff_comment_text(layer, normalized_text)
    self._refresh_tiff_list()
    if normalized_text:
        if had_existing:
            action = 'bijgewerkt'
        else:
            action = 'opgeslagen'
        self.set_status('Opmerking ' + str(action) + ' voor ' + str(layer.path.
            name) + '.')
        return None
    if had_existing:
        self.set_status('Opmerking verwijderd voor ' + str(layer.path.name) + '.')
        return None
    self.set_status('Geen opmerking opgeslagen.')
    return None

def _selection_view_bounds_for_layer(self, layer):
    size = self._canvas_size()
    aspect_ratio = max(1.0, size[0]) / max(1.0, size[1])
    longest_side = max(layer.bounds.width, layer.bounds.height, 1.0)
    target_long_side = max(self.TIFF_SELECTION_MIN_VIEW_METERS, longest_side *
        self.TIFF_SELECTION_SCALE_FACTOR)
    center_x = layer.bounds.center_x
    center_y = layer.bounds.center_y
    focus_bounds = Bounds(center_x - target_long_side / 2.0, center_y - 
        target_long_side / 2.0, center_x + target_long_side / 2.0, center_y + 
        target_long_side / 2.0)
    return focus_bounds.expand_to_aspect_ratio(aspect_ratio)

            preview_chainage)

        self.canvas.create_oval(preview_screen[0] - 6, preview_screen[1] - 6, 
            preview_screen[0] + 6, preview_screen[1] + 6, fill='#dbeafe',

            preview_screen[1], 'start ' + format(preview_chainage, '.2f') +
            ' m vanaf beginpunt')

    start_world = self._profile_display_world_point(layer, profile, float(self.
        dekband_pending_chainage))
    start_screen = self._world_to_screen(*start_world)
    self.canvas.create_oval(start_screen[0] - 6, start_screen[1] - 6, 
        start_screen[0] + 6, start_screen[1] + 6, fill='#ffffff', outline=

        self.dekband_pointer_world[0], self.dekband_pointer_world[1])
    end_world = self._profile_display_world_point(layer, profile, end_chainage)
    end_screen = self._world_to_screen(*end_world)
    self.canvas.create_line(start_screen[0], start_screen[1], end_screen[0],
        end_screen[1], fill='#2563eb', width=3, dash=(8, 4), tags=
        'interaction-overlay')
    self.canvas.create_oval(end_screen[0] - 5, end_screen[1] - 5, end_screen[0] +
        5, end_screen[1] + 5, fill='#dbeafe', outline='#2563eb', width=2, tags=
        'interaction-overlay')
    self._draw_virtual_trench_distance_badge(end_screen[0], end_screen[1], 
        'dekband ' + format(abs(end_chainage - float(self.
        dekband_pending_chainage)), '.2f') + ' m')
    return None

        self._redraw_canvas_overlays()

        return source
    max_radius = max(1, min(radius, width // 2, height // 2))
    mask = Image.new('L', (width, height), 0)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    draw.rounded_rectangle((0, 0, width - 1, height - 1), radius=max_radius,

def _draw_attribution(self, image, attribution):
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    text_bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), attribution)
    text_width = text_bbox[2] - text_bbox[0]
    text_height = text_bbox[3] - text_bbox[1]
    left = image.width - text_width - 22
    top = image.height - text_height - 16
    draw.rounded_rectangle((left - 8, top - 5, left + text_width + 8, top +
        text_height + 5), radius=8, fill=(255, 255, 255, 225), outline=(215, 
        221, 229))
    draw.text((left, top), attribution, fill=(35, 35, 35))
    return None

def _create_metric_tile(self, parent, title, value_var, column, accent):
    if accent:
        background = self.ACCENT
    else:
        background = self.SURFACE_SOFT
    if accent:
        foreground = self.SURFACE
    else:
        foreground = self.TEXT
    if accent:
        sub_foreground = self.SURFACE
    else:
        sub_foreground = self.MUTED
    if accent:
        border = self.ACCENT
    else:
        border = self.BORDER
    tile = tk.Frame(parent, background=background, highlightbackground=border,
        highlightthickness=1, bd=0)
    if column < 2:
        tile.grid(row=0, column=column, sticky='ew', padx=(0, 10))
        tk.Label(tile, text=title.upper(), font=('Segoe UI', 8, 'bold'),
            foreground=sub_foreground, background=background, anchor='w').grid(row
            =0, column=0, sticky='w', padx=10, pady=(8, 0))
        tk.Label(tile, textvariable=value_var, font=('Segoe UI', 10, 'bold'),
            foreground=foreground, background=background, anchor='w').grid(row=
            1, column=0, sticky='w', padx=10, pady=(2, 9))
        return tile
    else:
        tile.grid(row=0, column=column, sticky='ew', padx=(0, 0))
        tk.Label(tile, text=title.upper(), font=('Segoe UI', 8, 'bold'),
            foreground=sub_foreground, background=background, anchor='w').grid(row
            =0, column=0, sticky='w', padx=10, pady=(8, 0))
        tk.Label(tile, textvariable=value_var, font=('Segoe UI', 10, 'bold'),
            foreground=foreground, background=background, anchor='w').grid(row=
            1, column=0, sticky='w', padx=10, pady=(2, 9))
        return tile
